tasks.name: Latency benchmark and avoidable-call optimization
tasks.objective: Use the existing stage timing ledger and difficult-case corpus to build or strengthen a repeatable latency benchmark for Fast and Reviewed therapy paths, identify avoidable duplicate model work, and implement only behavior-preserving call or orchestration reductions that keep the same case formulation, graph plan, epistemic constraints, and realization contract.
acceptance: stage-specific latency measurements are retained
a deterministic or mock benchmark covers Fast and Reviewed paths
no therapy-routing, graph, safety, or epistemic rule is weakened
all existing tests, graph regressions, and package verification pass
independent review classifies any implementation change as non-substantive or restorative

tasks.name: Accessible audio playback and interruption recovery
tasks.objective: Harden browser speech playback so stop, pause, tab interruption, route changes, and page lifecycle transitions do not leave stale speech running or lose app state. Preserve the current therapy and hypnosis content contracts.
acceptance: speech can be stopped immediately
route changes cannot continue speech from an abandoned route
interruption and resume behavior is covered by deterministic web-client tests
no therapy or hypnosis policy changes are introduced
all package gates pass

tasks.name: Release packaging and local browser matrix
tasks.objective: Add a deterministic local release/package verification matrix that discovers the installed browser rather than hardcoding one executable, validates the package on the actual Node major version, and verifies clean install, rollback, loopback startup, and browser-open behavior without requiring user log transfer.
acceptance: browser executable discovery or explicit override is supported
the current Node major version is recorded and validated
atomic install and rollback are regression-tested
loopback startup is verified
all package gates pass

tasks.name: Component-scoped hypnosis regeneration
tasks.objective: Make hypnosis repair regenerate only failed structured components and their directly dependent transitions rather than rewriting the whole session, while preserving app-owned consent, route isolation, and waking-return contracts.
acceptance: failed-component repair scope is explicit and deterministic
unaffected components remain byte-identical across a scoped repair when no dependency requires change
app-owned gate and waking return remain outside model repair scope
hypnosis compiler tests and package gates pass
independent review finds no consent or safety weakening

tasks.name: Encrypted local storage design
tasks.objective: Design encrypted local storage and migration for therapy data before production release.
acceptance: requires a human decision on key management, recovery, migration, and data-loss tradeoffs before implementation
